description: This file defines RLS policies and helper functions for access control across various tables and roles in the database schema, including users, job_seekers, employers, education, experience, skills, seeker_skills, jobs, job_skills, applications, preferences, notifications, cms, integrations, audit_logs, analytics_events, seekers_embeddings, and jobs_embeddings.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Checks if a user UUID belongs to an admin user in the system.

methods.name: public.is_employer
methods.description: Checks if a user UUID belongs to an employer in the system.

methods.name: public.is_seeker
methods.description: Checks if a user UUID belongs to a job seeker in the system.

calls: exists (select 1 from public.users where id = u and user_type = 'admin')
exists (select 1 from public.users where id = u and user_type = 'employer')
exists (select 1 from public.users where id = u and user_type = 'job_seeker')
